lines.text: For surely Your enemies, O LORD,
But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox;
with fine oil I have been anointed.
My eyes see the downfall of my enemies;
my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
The righteous will flourish like a palm tree,
and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
Planted in the house of the LORD,
they will flourish in the courts of our God.
In old age they will still bear fruit;
healthy and green they will remain,
to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock,
and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”

pictures.scene: The Master of Cefalù, Christ Pantocrator of Cefalù Cathedral — Christ filling the gold of the apse with His hand raised in blessing and the open book held out, the Virgin and the archangels standing far below Him, but You, O LORD, are exalted forever, for surely Your enemies, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_cefalu_verheven

pictures.scene: Philips Wouwerman, Ruitergevecht — the horsemen breaking apart in the smoke with riders going down under the hooves, surely Your enemies will perish, all evildoers will be scattered
pictures.name: pd_wouwerman_verstrooid

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, David sacré roi par le prophète Samuel — the prophet pouring the horn of oil over the bowed head of the shepherd boy leaning on his staff, but You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox, with fine oil I have been anointed
pictures.name: pd_lorrain_gezalfd

pictures.scene: Raphael, The Expulsion of Heliodorus from the Temple — the horseman riding the plunderer down on the temple floor with the stolen gold spilling out of its vessel and the men crying out around him, my eyes see the downfall of my enemies, my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes
pictures.name: pd_raphael_ogen

pictures.scene: Tivadar Csontváry Kosztka, Pilgrimage to the Cedars of Lebanon — the great cedar standing over the white mountains with the pilgrims dancing in a ring under its branches, the righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon
pictures.name: pd_csontvary_ceder

pictures.scene: John Constable, Salisbury Cathedral from the Bishop's Grounds — the spire standing up out of the green close with the old trees planted around it and the cattle at the water, planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God
pictures.name: pd_constable_geplant

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Olive Trees — the old knotted trunks still carrying their whole weight of green and blue leaves over the bright ground, in old age they will still bear fruit, healthy and green they will remain
pictures.name: pd_vangogh_vrucht

pictures.scene: Alexandre Calame, Bei Handeck — the one fir standing straight on the mountainside under the great pale wall of rock, to proclaim, the LORD is upright, He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness
pictures.name: pd_calame_rots
